meta.title: Quantities to cost and sequence
meta.subtitle: One model, two deliverables
meta.description: Your model and your rate library produce a cost estimate and a 4D sequence, refreshed on every design update.
meta.alt: Animated diagram on a white background showing five stages left to right, joined by arrows with the file passing between them labelled on each line. Revit model and rate library arrive from the client; quantities are read from the model; they are priced against the library; two outputs follow, a cost estimate and a Navisworks sequence.
meta.caption: Both outputs regenerate from the same run. No re-entry between them.
